  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  February 12, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Community Room “A” 1st
Floor. On February 12, 2026, at 2:00 p.m.

Roll Call:  Members Present:
  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson , City Clerk’s Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the special meeting held on February 11, 2026

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Produced by 360 / David S. Harg on behalf of the City of Inglewood to host a 2026 Black
  History Celebration and Family Festival Event at Downtown Inglewood along Market
  Street from Regent to Hillcrest Blvd; Public Property, from Saturday, February 21, 2026,
  2026, from 11:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for 1 day
  event on Market Street between Regent St and Hillcrest Blvd and adjacent streets. Subject
  to Public Works approval for use/closure of the right-of-way. Applicant responsible for
  crowd control and event cleanup. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations. IPD will deploy
  one (1) Lieutenant, two (2) sergeants, fourteen (14) police officers for public safety, and
  fifteen (15) TCOs for street closures / traffic control. *VEHICLE BARRIERS WILL BE
  REQUIRED FOR THIS EVENT*. Adhere to all local, state and federal laws; No additional
  conditions needed for Fire Apprroval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned
  correctly immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this
  event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing
  safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00426418)

Item #2:  Micah Comeaux on behalf of Heluna Health to host a 5k Mommy Meet-Up Event at 3400
  W. Arbor Vitae St; Darby Park Public Property; on Saturday, April 25, 2026, from 10:00
  a.m. to 2:30 p.m APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for 1 day event at Darby Park.
  Subject to Parks and Rec approval for use of the park. Applicant responsible for crowd
  control and event cleanup. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations; Applicant to hire 2
  police officers for public safety and 2 TCO's for traffic control - safety in & around the Darby
  Park Parking lots. Adhere to all local, state and federal; None conditons for Code Approval;
  None conditions for Fire Approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned
  correctly immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this
  event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing
  safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00426430)

2026 - New Business License Request (s):
Item #3:  Adrea Feinstein on behalf of Fleet Mobility Solutions (CA) LLC to operate as a Bus Charter
  / Limousines service at 333 Hindry Ave; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO
  THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license renewal and tax
  fees; All employees must have current valid driver’s License.All vehicles must have proof
  of current valid vehicle registration and insurance at all times.If required a Class P-Charter
  Party Permit must be obtained. Applicant/owner shall NOT employ or have any 290 PC
  registrants employed or any persons that may pose a threat to the safety of patrons or the
  general public; Applicant needs a site plan review from Planning before permit is
  issued.Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will
  result in the revocation of your business license and any future Business License
  application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426496)
